manifest.method: per-image exhaustive hard-IoU-optimal subset over all 2^8 cluster subsets
manifest.label_use: each validation slice's ground-truth mask chooses that slice's prediction; oracle only
manifest.tie_break: higher hard IoU, then fewer clusters, then lower cluster IDs
manifest.refinement: same selected subset feeds unchanged soft F1 refinement; subset is not re-optimized for refined IoU
